# GitBook

Hosted GitBook sites (`*.gitbook.io` or a custom domain) and GitBook content synced to GitHub or GitLab. GitBook calls each content container a section (older docs: space); a site publishes one or more sections, each optionally with variants.

## Detect

- Rendered HTML has `<meta name="generator" content="GitBook ...">` and loads assets from `/~gitbook/static/` and `/~gitbook/image`.
- `<page-url>.md` returns markdown containing `{% hint %}`, `{% tabs %}` or `<figure>` blocks.
- In a repo: `.gitbook.yaml`, `SUMMARY.md`, `.gitbook/assets/`, `.gitbook/includes/`, or `gitbook-docs.yaml`.

## Get the source

### From the repo

A Git Sync repo, one per section and variant. Layout:

- `.gitbook.yaml`: `root` (content directory, default `./`), `structure.readme` (default `README.md`), `structure.summary` (default `SUMMARY.md`), `redirects`. Resolve all paths relative to `root`. Reference: https://gitbook.com/docs/docs-as-code/git-sync/content-configuration
- `SUMMARY.md`: the navigation and the inventory.
- `.gitbook/assets/`: uploaded images and files. `.gitbook/includes/`: reusable content. `.gitbook/vars.yaml`: section variables.
- `gitbook-docs.yaml`, when present, maps the site's sections to directories.

### From an export

The export is the Git Sync repo. The customer enables Git Sync per section with the direction GitBook → GitHub/GitLab into an empty repo, then gives you a clone. The opposite direction overwrites their GitBook content; tell them to confirm the direction. Repeat for every published section and variant. Steps: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/migration/gitbook.md

### From the live site

Every published page serves raw markdown at `<page-url>.md`; `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` list pages. `sitemap.xml` is a `<sitemapindex>` with one `sitemap-pages.xml` per section and language. Quirks (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, Mirror the raw source):

- The site or section root does not answer on `<root>.md`; fetch `<root>/readme.md`.
- Strip the leading `> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt]...` line and everything from `\n---\n# Agent Instructions...` to end of file.
- Published `.md` shows variable expressions, not their values. Resolve them from the rendered page.

Private sections, unpublished changes and reusable-content source are not reachable here (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, Gated content).

## Config → docs.json

GitBook site customization is not in the repo. Read it from the published HTML.

| GitBook                                                  | docs.json                                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Site title                                               | `name`                                                         |
| Logo (light/dark)                                        | `logo.light`, `logo.dark`                                      |
| Site icon / favicon                                      | `favicon`                                                      |
| Primary / tint color                                     | `colors.primary`                                               |
| Header links                                             | `navbar.links`                                                 |
| Footer links                                             | `footer.links`                                                 |
| Sections shown as top-level tabs                         | `navigation.tabs`                                              |
| Variants used for versions                               | `navigation.versions` if the customer migrates them            |
| Variants used for languages                              | `navigation.languages` if the customer migrates them           |
| `.gitbook/vars.yaml` variables                           | `variables` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags) |
| `.gitbook.yaml` `redirects` and site-level redirects     | `redirects` (see URLs and redirects)                           |
| Site sharing, visitor auth, adaptive content             | drop and report                                                |
| Integrations (analytics, chat, feedback), custom scripts | drop and report                                                |
| Search and AI assistant settings                         | drop and report                                                |

## Navigation

Walk `SUMMARY.md`. Without a repo, rebuild the same tree from the rendered sidebar of each section.

- `## Heading` lines become groups, in order.
- `* [Title](path.md)` becomes a page; indented children make it a nested group whose own page goes first.
- `[Title](path.md "Label")`: the quoted text is the sidebar label (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter).
- External links become navigation links where Mintlify supports them.
- Pages with frontmatter `hidden: true` stay reachable but out of navigation; (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- Page frontmatter `icon` maps to the page `icon` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Icons).

## Content conversion

Run these in order on every file. Match every `{% ... %}` with a non-greedy pattern such as `\{%[\s\S]*?%\}`, never `\{%[^%]*%\}`, because attribute values contain URL-encoded `%`.

| GitBook                                                                     | Mintlify                                                                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `{% hint style="info" %}`                                                   | `<Info>`                                                                                     |
| `{% hint style="success" %}`                                                | `<Check>`                                                                                    |
| `{% hint style="warning" %}`                                                | `<Warning>`                                                                                  |
| `{% hint style="danger" %}`                                                 | `<Danger>`                                                                                   |
| `{% tabs %}{% tab title="X" %}`                                             | `<Tabs><Tab title="X">`                                                                      |
| `{% stepper %}{% step %}`                                                   | `<Steps><Step title="...">`; title from the step's first heading or bold line, else `Step N` |
| `{% columns %}{% column %}`                                                 | `<Columns>`                                                                                  |
| `{% code title="f.js" lineNumbers="true" overflow="wrap" %}` around a fence | fence with `title="f.js"`, `lines`, `wrap`                                                   |
| `<details><summary>X</summary>`                                             | `<Accordion title="X">`                                                                      |
| `<table data-view="cards">`                                                 | `<CardGroup>` of `<Card>`; target from the `data-card-target` column                         |
| `{% content-ref url="x.md" %}` (and legacy `{% page-ref %}`)                | `<Card>` linking to the page                                                                 |
| `{% embed url="X" %}`                                                       | YouTube/video embed if supported, else a link `[X](X)`                                       |
| `{% file src="X" %}`                                                        | download link to the copied file                                                             |
| `{% include "../.gitbook/includes/x.md" %}`                                 | snippet (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                                |
| `{% updates %}` entries                                                     | `<Update>` (see `mint migrate --topic changelog`)                                            |
| `<code class="expression">space.vars.X</code>`, `page.vars.X`               | `{{X}}` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags)                                   |
| `$$...$$`                                                                   | LaTeX, unchanged                                                                             |
| `<a class="button primary" href>`                                           | plain link; report                                                                           |
| `<mark style="color:...">text</mark>`                                       | `text`                                                                                       |
| `<figure><img src alt><figcaption>` / `<picture><source srcset>`            | image with alt; keep a non-empty caption in `<Frame caption>`                                |

Then:

- Convert `<div data-gb-custom-block data-tag="hint|tabs|tab" ...>` variants to the same components as their `{% %}` forms, then drop remaining `data-gb-custom-block` openers and their closers.
- Strip any `{% ... %}` still present after mapping.
- Unescape GitBook backslash escapes (`\[ \] \( \) \{ \} \_ \*`) before MDX escaping.
- Remove the empty heading anchors GitBook emits (`<a href="#x" id="x"></a>` inside or above headings). GitBook heading ids differ from Mintlify's (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).

## Assets

- Repo: copy `.gitbook/assets/` into `images/` keeping relative structure. Asset filenames often contain spaces and parentheses (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- Live site: images appear as `/files/<id>`, `https://<n>-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/...?alt=media&token=...` and `/~gitbook/image?url=<encoded>` (a resized proxy; decode `url=` for the original).
- `/files/<id>` URLs that 404 on the site usually exist in `.gitbook/assets/`; recover them from the repo before reporting them missing.

## URLs and redirects

- Page URLs come from the `SUMMARY.md` hierarchy, not file paths. Keep each page at its published path; `README.md` pages publish at the directory path (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Files).
- Scraped markdown links pages by id: `/pages/<id>` and `/spaces/<id>/pages/<id>`. Resolve them from the rendered page links (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Links).
- Convert `.gitbook.yaml` `redirects` (old path → file) to `redirects`, prefixing the section path, because GitBook scopes them to one section (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects). Ask the customer for site-level redirects; they are not in the repo.
- The default variant may be served without its slug; add redirects for both forms.

## Known gaps

- Visitor authentication, adaptive content and site sharing settings.
- OpenAPI blocks: specs live at organization level, not in the section export. Ask the customer for the spec file or URL; then follow `mint migrate --topic api`.
- Buttons, inline icons (`<i class="fa-...">`), and integration blocks with no equivalent.
- Reusable content owned by a section outside the export.
